description: This file contains utility functions and classes for handling rendezvous endpoints, configuration parsing, hostname matching, and a periodic timer, specifically used within the context of PyTorch distributed elastic rendezvous mechanisms.

classes.name: _PeriodicTimer
classes.description: A class representing a timer that periodically executes a specified function in a background thread.

methods.name: _parse_rendezvous_config
methods.description: Parses a rendezvous configuration string into a dictionary of key-value pairs.

methods.name: _try_parse_port
methods.description: Attempts to parse a port number from a string.

methods.name: parse_rendezvous_endpoint
methods.description: Extracts hostname and port from a rendezvous endpoint string, with support for IPv6 and default port.

methods.name: _matches_machine_hostname
methods.description: Checks if a given hostname matches the current machine's hostname or IP addresses.

methods.name: _delay
methods.description: Suspends the current thread for a specified number of seconds or a random interval within a range.
